svg.text: 4 female–female Dupont jumpers · ESP32 DevKit V1 (30-pin) → Raspberry Pi 4
ESP32 VIN → Pi pin 2 (5V) power: Pi 5 V → ESP32 regulator
ESP32 GND → Pi pin 6 (GND) common ground
ESP32 D25 → Pi pin 5 (GPIO3) pulse low = wake the Pi from halt
ESP32 D26 → Pi pin 11 (GPIO17) pulse low = clean shutdown
